summary: Iteration 7 testing complete. Verified Reports exports (CSV, XLSX, Print), Data Backup/Restore (admin only, cashier forbidden, round-trip lossless), and rounding-drift absorption in close_session for unlinked multi-player sessions. All 7 backend pytest cases pass; frontend Reports flows all work. No blockers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py close_session drift-absorb block (L930-934) is correctly bounded to unlinked sessions AND 0 < credit <= 1.0; behaves as spec'd (small drift absorbed, larger drift rejected with 400 'Credit requires a linked player').

server.py /api/data/backup and /api/data/restore both gated by require_admin - confirmed 403 for cashier. Restore uses delete_many + insert_many per collection; round-trip preserved doc counts across all 10 collections in test.

Reports.jsx exportCSV/exportExcel: CSV header row matches spec exactly; XLSX contains all 6 required sheets (Summary, Invoices, Payment Methods, Top Players, Table Usage, Snack Sales) with correct headers - verified via openpyxl parsing.

Minor: /api/data/restore currently accepts any dict payload and wipes ALL matching collections found in payload. There's no validation of schema/ids - a malformed backup could leave DB in inconsistent state. Consider validating counter integrity (invoice seq) and rejecting payloads missing 'users' (would lock out admin). Not blocking for MVP.
Minor: /api/data/restore ignores collections it doesn't know about but also silently accepts unknown keys (they're processed via db[c]). Consider whitelisting collections.
seed_data_creation: Test players TEST_ITR7_* and a couple of closed sessions/invoices left in DB (harmless; consistent with prior iteration cleanup patterns).
